positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsKeptAsset
positions.frame: what distinguishes owning intelligence from renting access to it, and which layer — substrate or perspective — is the asset worth keeping?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same maxim-shaped opposition (owned vs. rented; commodity vs. asset), delivered in the same calm-positive, plain-spoken register and read across affect, register, value, style, and conviction as a single settled ownership thesis — src-2 states the categorical distinction, src-3 extends it into a substrate/perspective valuation. No tension: the two build one claim rather than opposing it.
